text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia (notably lymphopenia), thrombocytopenia, mild hypoglycemia, elevated ferritin, LDH, and INR, with low PT and ALT. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and impaired oxygenation, which may be seen in severe infection (e.g., viral pneumonia/COVID-19) or other acute inflammatory states. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
